children: FreeCast, Inc. (NASDAQ: CAST) today announced the launch of its comprehensive NFL information destination, bringing together information football fans can use throughout the season in one easy-to-use location.
The new destination is available at
and is built around a simple question millions of football fans increasingly face every week:
“Where can I watch the game?”
FreeCast answers that question while going considerably further.

The new NFL destination provides schedules, live scores, standings, team information, game details and, importantly, information helping consumers determine where individual games can be watched, including available free viewing options where applicable.

With NFL programming distributed across broadcast television, streaming services, subscription platforms and other viewing options, finding a particular game can sometimes be almost as challenging as following it.
FreeCast aims to simplify that experience.

“If there were a Super Bowl of NFL information, we want this to be the place,” said William Mobley, CEO of FreeCast. “Fans shouldn't have to search five different apps and websites just to figure out where a game is playing and whether they already have access to it. We want to tell you what's on, when it's on, where you can watch it, and when there is a free option, show you that too.”
Everything NFL. One Starting Point.
FreeCast's NFL destination is designed as a season-long resource rather than simply another sports scores page.
Fans can use the destination to:
See where to watch NFL games
Identify available free viewing options, including eligible over-the-air broadcasts
Connect to available viewing sources and promotions
Follow schedules and kickoff times
Track live scores
Review NFL standings
Explore individual teams and their schedules
Navigate viewing choices from one centralized destination
The objective is straightforward: before searching the internet, checking multiple streaming apps or trying to determine which network has a game, start with FreeCast.
Helping Solve a Fragmented Viewing Experience
The way consumers watch professional football has changed dramatically.

Games are distributed through traditional broadcast networks, free over-the-air television, streaming platforms and subscription television packages. Different games may require different viewing sources throughout the same week.
FreeCast sees that fragmentation as an example of the broader media-navigation problem its platform was designed to address.
Rather than asking consumers to begin with a particular network or streaming service, FreeCast begins with the content the consumer wants to watch and helps identify available paths to it.
For NFL fans, that means starting with the game.
Find the game. See the score. Check the standings. Find out where it's playing. Discover whether there's an available free option. Then watch.
Mobley added:

“The internet has given consumers more ways to watch television than ever before, but more choices have also created more confusion. FreeCast's job is to help organize those choices. NFL football is a perfect example of why that matters.”
Free Television Remains Part of the Equation

FreeCast is also highlighting an option that can sometimes be overlooked amid the growth of paid streaming services: certain NFL games broadcast by local television stations may be available free over the air to consumers in applicable broadcast markets with compatible reception equipment.
FreeCast's broader television platform is designed to help consumers identify television and streaming options, alongside free streaming channels and connections to additional streaming services.

The company's NFL destination extends that consumer-first philosophy to professional football: help consumers identify available legitimate viewing choices rather than requiring them to begin with a particular service.
One Page. Every Week. All Season.
FreeCast intends for its NFL destination to serve as an ongoing resource throughout the season, with schedules, scores, standings and viewing information available through the destination.
Fans can visit:
Everything you need to follow the NFL—including where to watch it, free or otherwise—in one place.
About FreeCast

FreeCast, Inc. (NASDAQ: CAST) is a media and streaming technology company providing consumer and enterprise solutions designed to simplify access to television and streaming media. FreeCast's platform brings together free and paid streaming content, local television, subscription services, discovery, account management and monetization capabilities into a unified media ecosystem across connected devices.
For more information, visit freecast.com.
